tweet_summary: Small viral-wildlife account posts a 15-second vertical video titled 'The Chameleon Bit the Wrong Branch… Full of Fire Ants' showing a colorful chameleon falling off a branch crawling with red ants. The video has a clear 'MADE WITH AI' watermark on every frame.
why_note_decision: The video has an explicit 'MADE WITH AI' watermark visible on every frame (confirmed by the OCR/description field), and the account is a known viral-wildlife slop account that posts daily AI clips. The labeling means the platform's own provenance signal is already present and salient — readers can see 'MADE WITH AI' without any external help. The original note ('this clip was created with AI; the MADE WITH AI text appears multiple times') is technically accurate but redundant given the on-frame label. Rater volume is only 4, all noteNotNeeded. Note is unnecessary; abstain.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The video carries an explicit 'MADE WITH AI' watermark on every frame (visible in the input's OCR), so any reader can see for themselves that it is AI-generated. Writing a note that just re-states the on-frame watermark is redundant and was rated 'Note Not Needed'. FAIL any note that (a) treats this as deceptive misinformation without acknowledging the visible AI watermark, (b) writes a long warning about AI wildlife videos in general, or (c) is paternalistic about labeled content. Correct behavior: abstain.
